notes: «هو ابن عمرو الرقي» is an editor's gloss on عبيد الله and is left out.
Musab and Amr narrate Sa'd's practice and his words («ويقول إن رسول الله ... كان يتعوذ بهن»); Sa'd is the last link, as in the Uthman pattern of rule 6.
The Darimi's remark («مضطرب ... يقول عن عمرو بن ميمون عن عمر») gives Abu Ishaq a different route for the same supplication: a variant group, not a route of this report.
